name: otelux
description: Investigate local OpenTelemetry traces, logs, metrics, errors, and latency with OTelux.

interface.longDescription: Query the OTelux desktop store through read-only MCP tools, investigate incidents and slow traces, summarize service health, and hand off evidence to the visual OTelux workbench.
defaultPrompt: Use OTelux to investigate recent errors and identify the most likely root cause.
Use OTelux to find the slowest local traces and explain their critical paths.
Summarize service health from the telemetry currently stored in OTelux.
